title: Efficacy and Safety Study of Zinc Acetate to Treat Wilson's Disease in Japan.
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether Zinc Acetate is effective and safe in the treatment of Wilson's disease among Japanese.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Wilson's disease(adult,infant,pregnant woman)

Exclusion Criteria:

* acute hepatitis
* malignant tumor
